project_type: PM2 process monitor + control panel: Node/TypeScript ESM backend (Express REST + ws WebSocket hub) with a vanilla HTML/JS/CSS dashboard under public/ (no bundler).
language: TypeScript (strict), ESM NodeNext. Relative imports MUST carry the .js extension. Dashboard is plain ES-module JavaScript.
build_system: tsc via package.json scripts. Quirks: module/moduleResolution NodeNext (so .js on relative imports), rootDir src, outDir dist, target ES2022, strict true, skipLibCheck true. No bundler for the dashboard — files are served statically from public/.
test_framework: node:test executed through tsx. The npm test script is `tsx --test $(find src -name '*.test.ts')`. Tests use injected fakes/timers (not real sockets/daemons) — see src/testutil/fakePm2Client.ts and the injected setTimer/clearTimer/now pattern in Pm2Client/WsHub. ~164 tests currently pass (verified: 0 fail).
verification_instructions: After each feature: run `npm run build` (must compile clean under strict/NodeNext) then `npm test` (all suites green, including the preserved ~164 standalone tests plus the feature's new tests). Grep is NOT verification. The final smoke (FEAT-005) also runs a scripted one-server/one-agent hub-and-spoke: agent appears online in GET /api/agents, a control command round-trips, live logs stream in the dashboard drill-down, an alias persists across a server restart, and MODE unset still serves the identical standalone dashboard.
snapshot_or_generated_files: None. `npm run build` emits to dist/ which is gitignored. No codegen/snapshot files are checked in.
environment_constraints: Work only in this worktree (branch feat/multi-instance); do NOT create a new worktree. Step cwd is the main workspace, so always use ABSOLUTE paths. The agent/server runtimes must never crash on an unreachable peer. The agent opens NO inbound port. No new runtime dependency may be added — the agent's outbound client uses the already-present `ws` package. PM2 access stays confined to src/pm2/client.ts (the only pm2 import site).
contribution_requirements: No AGENTS.md/CONTRIBUTING/.kiro steering exist in this repo. Follow the established in-repo patterns strictly: new config flows through the single zod schema in src/config/env.ts (a ZodEffects — add keys inside the existing z.object literal before the trailing .superRefine, add cross-field guards inside the existing superRefine body; do NOT use .extend/.merge or a second .superRefine; keep AppConfig = z.infer<typeof configSchema>). Credentials compared ONLY via throw-safe safeEqual (src/api/auth.ts). Wire messages are zod discriminated unions validated by a codec that never throws. Secret keys added to logger REDACTED_KEYS. Standalone (MODE unset) stays byte-for-byte behaviorally unchanged (hard constraint NFR-1). The REST envelope is { error: { code, message } }.
key_patterns: Narrow injectable dependency surfaces (StateDeps/Pm2Deps/EngineDeps in src/api/server.ts) so tests inject fakes. Injected clock/timers (now/setTimer/clearTimer) throughout. Typed event bus MonitorEvents (src/core/events.ts). Wire-reusable core shapes in src/core/types.ts (ProcessSnapshot/MetricSample/LogLine/TrackedError/MonitorSnapshot) and ControlResult/StartNewOpts/ControlAction in src/pm2/client.ts. Backoff: base 1s, cap 30s, +/-20% jitter (currently inline in Pm2Client#backoffDelay). WsHub attaches ws WebSocketServer in noServer mode on the shared http.Server, handles only pathname '/ws' and yields (returns without destroying) on other paths — reserved for a future second WS path. processNameSchema charset is /^[A-Za-z0-9._-]{1,100}$/. createProcess validates a { body: {...} } envelope, is .strict(), and transforms instances>1 + no exec_mode to exec_mode:'cluster'. redactContext recurses nested plain objects to full depth but NOT into arrays; redactUrl strips token= query values.
